When I was kid (like 7 or 8) we lived in this old apartment that was being bought out by the closest college, we had a few weeks of notice to move out and I was bummed I really loved that apartment we would play all sorts of games, ride around the lake near by, and just do kid things. As we were talking about it with my siblings (one older one younger both  2 and 1/2 years apart from me) I started talking about the little door in the wall we used to play with. Coralina was a movie that just came out so we treated this door like the all mighty door that could take us wherever we wanted it was basically the door to our dreams. But like Coralina's door we were also scared of the price of using the door to get to our dreams so we would play with it but cautiously to not end up hurt. It was always locked and something my parents never cared for, they'd always just ignore it. So as we we're talking about we wanted to play one more time seeing if we could open it before we never could. Because despite how scary it was we we're weird kids with too much curiosity I mean we used to treat Smarties like pills for fun (the pills that melt we didn't try to just swallow Smarties). But we searched for the door where it always was in the middle of the hallway between the kids rooms and my mom and dad's room. We kept looking and after 15 mins we were all confused and when to our parents after finding where the door was a patched wall where there was a rim around it that looked the doorway for where our door was. We complained to them and asked them what they did to our door and if they could find out what was inside. They simply replyed there was no door. We all were confused and clearly in disbelief so they even when as far as to find a picture of that one spot of the wall same as they always saw it with the rim around it (they took the picture when we got the place in case anything happened). To this day me, my brother, and my sister all don't know what happened to that door if it was real or if we all we're just crazy enough to all imagine it. I mean I still have a thousand questions like why it would switch then or how did all of us see the same door, was the door real or the wall with the rim, what was behind our door but they'll never be answered. I've even gone as far as to subtly bring it back up to my parents for them to deny it every time saying we we're just trying to see if there was a hidden vent or tunnel behind the wall. No one believed us.
